overview_description.description:
CARESQUARE is a patient's Healthcare digital platform providing integrated medical services with guidance in Patient Journey, providing booking doctors, getting discounts on pharma orders and lab tests, keeping medical reports for self & family members.

Its also a trusted partner for healthcare providers by helping them to extend their digital reach, boost their branding, manage their clinics , records and the traffic of patients.
